business_summary: HDFC Mutual Fund - HDFC Sensex ETF is an exchange traded fund co-launched by Housing Development Finance Corporation Limited and Standard Life Investments Limited. It is managed by HDFC Asset Management Company Ltd. The fund invests in the public equity markets of India. It seeks to invest in the stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. The fund invests in the stocks of large-cap companies. It seeks to replicate the performance of the S&P BSE SENSEX Index. HDFC Mutual Fund - HDFC Sensex ETF was formed on November 30, 2015 and is domiciled in India.
